item.title: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers
item.content:encoded:
Greetings there, fellow SCP enthusiasts!

I am Seereeni (Seh-re-nii), and after roughly 5 years of knowing about and following the SCP universe, I decided to make an account of my own, and contribute to this wonderful place in whatever way I can.

One of mine own desires is to write an SCP, humanoid at that, which can then by used by everyone here, veteran and newbie, to link together all the SCPs, in one way or another, either for tales, to create new SCPs, to write interesting logs, or to explain something which they find hard to explain.

Hard? Oh yes, that's how a challenge should be.

I am also a writer on Fanfiction, as as far as my readers have commented, I am apparently almost typo-free in my writing. Do you have a tale or SCP you wish someone to look over for typos? Then do contact me, I am more than happy to help.

Lastly, as you have probably noticed, I am very…detailed in my explanations. This is, naturally, a good thing for a writer, but less so for an SCP Foundation member, something I am very much aware of. I have read the rules and I know that an SCP page should be professional and not use more words than needed. I will try my best to abide by these rules.

With that said, I still have a hard time understanding how this site works. So many links directing one to other links, then to other links…sigh. I barely know how Discord works.

Thus, to all of you veterans who have taken it upon themselves to answer newbie questions….I pity you, and I am sorry. I'll try to learn fast and keep your suffering minimal.

Kay bye.

item.title: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers
item.content:encoded:
Salutations one and all,
I go by JoysticKnight (I imagine you could shorten that to Jsk if it's a little much to type out).

I tend to be an avid enthusiast of design. I like to break apart the inner workings of all this world has to offer. Be it science, psychology, philosophy, art, traditional/video-games, or music to name a few large topics. Although, I do have a particular affinity towards music analysis, and game design.

As far as the foundation is concerned, I've seen it's growth over the years with the wealth of it's library and the troves of content people make concerning it. I indeed have adored the vast imagination of it's machinations showing thoroughly no true limit to the vastness of this world. And it's by this merit I have finally grown enough gall to even consider joining.

Personally speaking I tend to be a shelled and hermit-like in nature. So forgive me if it takes some time to flourish in any way. I have something of a social life, but tend to not act upon it, so participating in a forum or collective source is a rather new experience for me.

I hope that as time marches on I am able to contribute in some forward manner, gaining people's trust and flame of curiousity. Until then, I am but still just another peer.

Also I obvisouly don't talk with this much grandure in real life, it's just nice every once in a while to really convey the right emotions with fitting words.

So about that question. I suppose I'll go with water, it's an endlessly malleable substance that we learn does something new every 5 years or so. I admire it's ability to function and create function.

item.title: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers
item.content:encoded:
Hello fellow humans, at least two dogs and an army of birds,

I remember reading 173 when it was originally circulating, or I guess… trickling down from /x/ to reddit.
Now there are 6000 SCPs, so I read all 5561 of them. Probably. Last night I read Captain Kirby's "End of Death" series and I have several questions that cannot - and must not - be answered.

I hope I can contribute useful information about the wiki. I'm currently building a program that scrapes the wiki for specific page types, caches the "meat" of each one, and lets me perform offline, human-assisted analytics. When the proof of concept is done, I'll be able to tell you how many SCPs are "spooky broadcast receivers". Hint: It's a lot.

Mainly, I joined the wiki because the HP 28c does not have an equals>display button, and the notes should be updated to reflect correct use of Reverse Polish Notation.

QOTM: Fire. I am energetic, require care to manage, and must balance myself between burning down a forest and settling into embers.

item.title: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers
item.content:encoded:
Hello Abe Estos,

Welcome to the site! The SCP Wiki is a great place for writers of all levels, so you've come to the right spot.

For advice in critiquing, I recommend checking out our critique threads here in the forums, and looking at the posts stickied at the top of each list. Here you'll find all the relevant info in regards to giving feedback, and all relevant rules to follow.

For advice in writing, I'm going to leave you with my writer's resources. It contains links to all the places to get started/what to read first/ect. Do keep in mind there is no rush to contribute, so if you're not quite ready to, don't! Reading, exploring the site, and seeing what all you like are also wonderful places to start.

If you have any questions/concerns, feel free to reach out, otherwise, enjoy your time here!

+A gift of resources just for you
-Hope this helps!

Maybe you've already seen these before, maybe you haven't, but hopefully something here is of use to you. Of course, if you have any questions, feel free to reach out!

First off, there are some required readings for all site authors. Consider giving them a read, as well as all the other helpful guides on this Guide Hub. The more familiar you are with the processes that take place on the Site, the better your chances of success are!

Now that that's done - Got an idea? Or maybe a few? You can create a Sandbox page to store all your ideas and drafts in an orderly fashion.

Okay, but maybe you're not sure if your concept is ready to be fleshed out, or perhaps it just needs some heavy refinement. If that's the case, you can run things by the community in the Ideas and Brainstorming forum.

Once you believe you have a solid draft, you can go ahead and make a thread in the Drafts and Critiques forum. Keep in mind though you should check the stickied posts first on how best to use each of the forums.

Best of luck writing!

item.title: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers
item.content:encoded:
Heya, PilotForrest. Welcome to the SCP Wiki!

Seeing that you have quite a few interests, you should check out our IRC chatrooms. It's a great atmosphere, and there's tons of people to talk about your interests with. Don't worry if your writing isn't the best now; everyone started somewhere, and reading and getting critique will definitely help. As for your question, each article has a set of tags for certain attributes that may have. If you find an article that you like, and are looking for similar stuff, you can scroll down to the bottom left of the page, and click on the tag you are most interested in. Anyways, here's some stuff you may want to check out that'll hep you:

Navigation:

+ show block
– hide block

If you want to keep up with the latest material, check out the Most Recently Created page. If you'd rather check out only the most popular new articles, then Top Rated New Pages is the way to go.

While you're browsing, if you find an article you absolutely love, you can try finding more from the same author by looking them up on the Authors' Page hub. If the user in question is not on that list, you can try searching for them on our statistic site, scpper.com.

If there are some SCPs that you're a fan of, you can try checking out a new addition to the wiki: the SCP Series Tales List, created by yours truly. These are pages that mirror the main SCP listings, but they include all the stories that feature each SCP (for example, one can find everything that has been written about SCP-173).

Recommendations:

+ show block
– hide block

With the amount of SCPs we have, it can be hard to find really good articles in specific genres (not to mention we have no way of searching by genre), so I took it upon myself to curate a few lists of some good representative material to share with other users. With the help of various community members, User-Curated Lists has been built to facilitate fun wikiwalks of some amazing content!

With that said, I hope your time here is amazing

item.title: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers
item.content:encoded:
Note: If you're going to introduce yourself here, please scroll down and click "New Post" and NOT "reply", otherwise your comment will nest incorrectly!

Hello, new site members/artists/gamers/social media watchers/roleplayers/etc.!

This month's random question is: of the classical elements (fire, water, air, earth), which represents you the most, and why?

Here's some places to talk to get you all started off, now that you've arrived:

  • Games and Hobbies forum: Just started playing a new game or are wondering if any other SCP site members play your favorite game? Alternatively, wondering if anyone else paints minifigures or goes to conventions? Jump into the conversations here.
  • Media Discussion forum: Have a cool video or news article that just screams of the paranormal? Talk about it and other such things here!
  • Fan Work forum: Have a cool drawing or want to see the work of some of the other artists here? Have an SCP-based mod or board game in the works? This is the place to discuss!

If you're not sure what to talk about here, you can take a look at our How to Write an Intro/Welcome thread for ideas.

Have fun mingling with the other new arrivals and talking about your interests, hobbies, and plans for taking over the universe. You might also see some of our veteran users here from time to time, since you never know when someone might be looking for an artist or a voice actor or an idea-haver for the next big collaboration article or SCP project! Talk and be merry. :)

Welcome to the site!
